title: Stand to the End
prompt: Mike has been standing motionless in the middle of the desert for over a day. He is all alone and has neither food nor water, but he doesn't leave the spot. What's going on?
solution: Mike thinks his foot is on a mine, though it is not. He and his partner had been ordered to kill terrorists, but the operation failed. A sandstorm helped them escape and they ended up in the desert without noticing that they were in a minefield. Suddenly Mike's partner was blown up by a mine and died. At the same moment Mike took a step and clearly heard something click under his foot, and he froze, believing he had triggered a mine fuse: if he lifted his foot, the mine would explode. He told his superiors over the radio, and they said they could only help him in 52 hours, so he decided to wait. A day later he was suffering from the heat and beginning to hallucinate. He never knew that the click was not a mine, but a tin can left in the desert by someone else who had been blown up in the same field.
